assessment.rationale: No open or discoverable solution gives anyone a once-a-year senescent-cell clearance treatment, so the Main KPI of 1,000,000,000 people treated yearly is not met by existing work. No senolytic has regulatory approval (industry review, March 2026); dasatinib+quercetin and fisetin are investigational multi-day cycles in small trials (SEN-SURVIVORS NCT04733534) and Unity's UBX1325 is a local eye injection with mixed phase 2 results (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12910722). The nearest single-dose, long-acting results are preclinical: anti-uPAR senolytic CAR T cells persisting over 15 months after one infusion in mice (Amor et al., Nature Aging 2024, https://www.nature.com/articles/s43587-023-00560-5) and GPNMB senolytic vaccination in progeroid mice (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37117524/). Open source exists only upstream of therapy: senolytic screening code at https://github.com/felixjwong/senolyticsai. Partial leads, not the end goal; tasks that merely replicate them must carry their own prior-art basis.

additionalSearches.query: senolytic once-yearly single dose treatment clinical trial 2026
additionalSearches.finding: No once-yearly senolytic regimen in trials. No senolytic approved as of March 2026; D+Q and fisetin used in short repeated courses, off-label.

additionalSearches.query: senolytic CAR T cells uPAR long-lasting single infusion aging Nature Aging
additionalSearches.finding: Amor et al. 2024: one infusion of anti-uPAR CAR T cells improved metabolic function in aged mice and persisted over 15 months. Mice only; no human programme.

additionalSearches.query: FDA approved senolytic drug status Unity Biotechnology UBX1325 dasatinib quercetin fisetin trial results
additionalSearches.finding: No approved senolytic; UBX1325 phase 2 outcomes conflicting; D+Q dosed three days per 28-day cycle; no large blinded outcome trial completed.

additionalSearches.query: github open source senolytic drug discovery senescent cell clearance
additionalSearches.finding: Open code covers compound screening and senolytic prediction (Wong et al., Nature Aging 2023), not a delivered yearly treatment; no maintained open therapy platform found.

additionalSearches.query: senolytic vaccine GPNMB senescent cells mice long-term
additionalSearches.finding: GPNMB senolytic vaccination improved age-related phenotypes and lifespan in progeroid mice; preclinical, GPNMB not senescence-specific, no human trial.
